name: CLIProxyAPI Usage
description: Token and request usage of your CLIProxyAPI server per model and account, in a sidebar panel and the status bar.

settings.title: CLIProxyAPI URL
settings.description: Base URL of the CLIProxyAPI server, without /v1 or /v8/management. https:// for remote servers (plain http:// only for localhost); remote servers also need management.allow-remote: true. The management key is sent only to the server it was saved for.

settings.title: Poll interval (seconds)
settings.description: How often the usage queue is read. Keep it below the server's usage queue retention (observability.usage.redis-usage-queue-retention-seconds, 60 seconds by default), or records expire unread.

settings.title: Days of history to keep
settings.description: Local calendar days kept, today included. A longer range in the panel shows only these days.
